required_fields.actual_frame_timestamps_available: boolean; true for usable capture, false permitted only for failed capture
required_fields.timestamp_source: nonempty string describing hardware/software timestamp source for usable capture; null permitted only for failed capture
required_fields.video_file_id: nonempty string for usable capture; null permitted only for failed capture when no usable file exists
required_fields.video_file_sha256: 64 lowercase hex characters for usable capture; null permitted only for failed capture when no usable file exists
required_fields.maze_fiducial_definition_id: nonempty string for usable calibration; null permitted only when coordinate_calibration_status=failed and fiducials are unavailable
required_fields.coordinate_calibration_method: nonempty string for usable calibration; null permitted only when coordinate_calibration_status=failed and calibration cannot be performed
required_fields.coordinate_calibration_rms_error_mm: number <=0.1 when coordinate_calibration_status=usable; when failed, null if calibration is unavailable or the observed numeric RMS value may be >0.1; never fabricate an in-tolerance value
required_fields.session_deviation: null or text; any deviation preserved, and failed capture must describe the failure

consistency_rules: if video_capture_status=usable then actual_frame_timestamps_available must be true, timestamp_source and video_file_id must be nonempty, and video_file_sha256 must be 64 lowercase hex characters

if video_capture_status=failed then actual_frame_timestamps_available may be false and timestamp_source, video_file_id, and video_file_sha256 may be null when unavailable; never fabricate file identifiers, hashes, or timestamps

if video_capture_status=failed then session_deviation must nonemptily describe the capture/tracking failure and any affected trial must use the preregistered verified_video_or_tracking_failure_preventing_endpoint_determination technical exclusion
a failed-capture record remains a conforming session provenance record and is joined by session_id even when no usable video file exists
no endpoint choice or timeout may be inferred from a failed capture without valid endpoint evidence
if coordinate_calibration_status=usable then maze_fiducial_definition_id and coordinate_calibration_method must be nonempty and coordinate_calibration_rms_error_mm must be numeric <=0.1

if coordinate_calibration_status=failed then unavailable fiducial/method/RMS fields may be null, an observed out-of-tolerance RMS may be recorded numerically, session_deviation must describe the failure, and affected trials must use verified_video_or_tracking_failure_preventing_endpoint_determination; never fabricate calibration provenance

endpoint_processing_contract.crossing_rule: linearly interpolate each consecutive valid thorax/mesosoma centroid segment over actual timestamps and solve earliest outside-to-inside segment-circle intersection; boundary distance <=7.0 mm counts as inside
